fields.display_title: This paper introduces a method for performing safe exploration in RL. It addresses the problem of ensuring that partially-trained policies do not visit unsafe regions of the state space, while still being exploratory enough to collect useful training experiences. This method makes fewer assumptions than those required by related techniques. The experiments are well-designed and convincing, and include evaluations of the proposed method (CSC) in 4 different domains.
